verdict.rationale: Nix is a package manager, so verifying fetched packages is a fair question, but the pack has no first-party documentation of checksum, signature, or attestation checks on downloads or binary-cache substitutes. The binary-cache docs (nix-docs-36) never mention signing. The community note that reproducible builds let you verify a source by its hash (nix-comm-19) describes manual user verification, not documented automatic verification before execution. Hermetic-closure and declared-dependency remarks (nix-comm-18, nix-docs-59) are adjacent features and earn no credit.
